clusters.headline: MPR Verifies Cawapres Files And Consults Experts On Election
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR verification team examined legal records for vice presidential candidates Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono at the Supreme Court.
Parliamentary officials are consulting three constitutional law experts regarding the mechanism for filling the vacant vice presidential office.
